title: dots setup
brief: Guided post-install setup: ordered steps, shell choice, login steps run in the terminal, status summary. Same palette as dots home (pkg/ui/styles.go).

artboards.tradeoff: Matches the real terminal output exactly; less visual weight

artboards.title: Split panel
artboards.tradeoff: Shows the command and its verification for the active step; more space needed
